messages.subject: Time recording - March narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Our records show 6.5 hours unposted for the period 16-31 March against matter WC-00207 and others. Please complete your time narratives by close of play Wednesday so we can raise the month-end bills. Thank you.
